stem: A container remains wet for a long period after irrigation and roots show reduced vigor. Which root-zone property should be evaluated rather than assuming the issue is only fertilizer concentration?
choices: The balance among water-holding capacity, air-filled porosity, bulk density and drainage behavior of the medium
Only the printed nutrient ratio on the fertilizer label
Only the color of the container
rationale: Root-zone performance depends on physical properties that influence water retention and aeration. Excess water retention can limit oxygen availability even when nutrient concentration is unchanged.
